context:
Goal: the past-ruling check stops refusing because a healthy model call was slow.
Problem (rule): the call (15 s) plus the #1422 retry (10 s) already fill the Stop hook's 35 s limit, so a longer call needs a longer hook limit in settings.json, and only you set that.
Based on (read): hooks/call_judge.py PAST_RULING_TIMEOUT is 15 s; #1422 adds PAST_RULING_RETRY_TIMEOUT 10 s plus a 10 s start-up allowance.
Based on (notes): how often it times out is unmeasured; #1431 logs each timeout once it merges.
Departs from: main's 35 s Stop limit and 15 s call — the limit and both tries grow (a, b), or stay until the log reads (c).
After you pick, type the pick in the lane's chat (https://claude.ai/code/session_013NEJKzQsAzQkvsohtkLuJP): a settings.json change needs your typed words in the session that makes it.

options.gain: Slow but healthy calls pass, with the most headroom.
options.how: Raise the Stop hook to 50 s in settings.json, the first call to 25 s and the retry to 15 s.
options.label: Stop limit 50 s: first try 25 s, retry 15 s
options.lose: A stuck model can hold the end of a relaying turn for up to about 50 s.

options.gain: A shorter worst-case wait than a.
options.how: Raise the Stop hook to 45 s, the first call to 20 s and the retry to 15 s.
options.label: Stop limit 45 s: first try 20 s, retry 15 s
options.lose: Less headroom, so more slow calls may still be refused.

options.gain: The limit rests on a measured rate.
options.how: Merge #1431, read its timeout log, then choose a limit from the measured rate.
options.label: Keep 35 s and decide after the timeout log
options.lose: Refusals keep reaching you until the log has enough runs.
